## Design decisions

- **`make docs-check` is CI-only, NOT in `make check`.** Measured locally the two detectors together take **~30s** (the agent detector's file-index walk alone ~23s), over the ~10s inner-loop budget. `make check` semantics are unchanged (additive/back-compat). Recorded in ADR-072.
- **Detector `/build/` quirk (documented in ADR-072 §Consequences):** `check-agent-docs-freshness.sh` excludes any path containing `/build/`, so backticked references to `docs/build/*.md` files read as "missing" (this caused all 5 baseline criticals). The docs reference `docs/build/` as a *directory* instead of naming files — the required-string `docs/build/` is satisfied and the false positives are avoided **without modifying the vendored logic**.
- **ADR-072 Appendix F row deferred (deviation):** SIG-ENG-039 asks for an Appendix F row when an ADR is added, but that requires editing `spec_src` + regenerating `docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md` — **out of P22.2 scope** (human-facing/generated docs are P22.1's). `check_spec_src.py` is **not** wired into `make check`/CI, so this does not break the green gate. Flag for the next spec-reconciliation / capstone.
